# Little Flower School, Salempur — Complete Institutional Overview & Knowledge Base

## 1. General Information
- **Full Legal Name**: Little Flower School, Salempur
- **Short Name**: LFS Salempur
- **Motto**: "For God and Man"
- **Founding Society**: Little Flower Mission Education Society, Gorakhpur (Administered by CST Fathers - Little Flower Congregation)
- **Affiliation**: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE), New Delhi (ICSE Class X and ISC Class XII)
- **Medium of Instruction**: English (Hindi as compulsory language, Sanskrit offered)
- **School Type**: Co-Educational Day School, Christian Minority Institution
- **Campus Address**: Little Flower School, Salempur, Deoria District, Uttar Pradesh - 274509, India
- **Contact Numbers**: +91 94533 44112, +91 87659 32092
- **Official Email**: littleflowersalempur@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://lfssalempur.online
- **Online Fees Payment Portal**: https://www.lfssalempur.online/payonline/

---

## 3. Vision, Mission & Core Philosophy
- **Vision**: To be a centre of excellence in education for the transformation of the individual and community, grounded in the principles of Love, Justice and Truth.
- **Mission**: To accompany students, teachers and parents in joyful learning and to inspire responsible citizens who uphold human values and contribute to nation building.
- **Motto Meaning**: "For God and Man" — an enduring call to serve with humility, learn with purpose, and live with integrity.

---

## 4. Academic Structure & Streams
LFS Salempur offers a comprehensive curriculum spanning pre-primary to senior secondary levels:
- **Pre-Primary**: LKG & UKG (Foundational play-way learning, phonetics, motor skills)
- **Primary**: Classes I to V (Foundational literacy, numeracy, environmental studies, arts, moral science)
- **Middle School**: Classes VI to VIII (Mathematics, Integrated Sciences - Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Social Studies, English Language & Literature, Hindi, Sanskrit, Computer Applications)
- **Secondary (ICSE - Class IX & X)**: 
  - Group I (Compulsory): English Language & Literature, Hindi, History, Civics & Geography
  - Group II: Mathematics, Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) / Commercial Studies / Economics
  - Group III: Computer Applications / Physical Education / Commercial Applications / Art
- **Senior Secondary (ISC - Class XI & XII)**:
  - **Science Stream**: English, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics / Biology, Computer Science / Physical Education
  - **Commerce Stream**: English, Accounts, Commerce, Economics, Mathematics / Business Studies / Physical Education
  - **Humanities Stream**: English, History, Political Science, Economics, Geography / Psychology

---

## 5. Campus Facilities & Infrastructure
1. **Science Laboratories**: State-of-the-art Physics, Chemistry, and Biology laboratories equipped with modern precision apparatus for hands-on experimentation.
2. **Computer Labs**: High-speed internet enabled computer labs with individual workstations for algorithmic thinking and coding.
3. **Library & Reading Room**: Well-stocked library featuring thousands of academic reference books, journals, classics, fiction, and periodicals in English and Hindi.
4. **Sports Complex & Playgrounds**: Full-sized football pitch, cricket ground, athletic track, basketball court, volleyball court, badminton courts, and indoor sports equipment.
5. **Chapel & Assembly Hall**: Sacred reflective space at the heart of campus for morning prayer, meditation, and general school assemblies.
6. **Smart Classrooms**: Audio-visual interactive panels to facilitate dynamic digital pedagogy.
7. **Safe Transport & Clean Campus**: Purified drinking water (RO plants), hygienic sanitation facilities, and CCTV surveillance throughout the campus.

---

## 6. Admissions Information
- **Classes Open**: LKG to Class VIII (Higher secondary admissions depend on seat availability and merit).
- **Admission Process**:
  1. Enquiry and collection of prospectus / online registration.
  2. Submission of completed application form along with candidate's birth certificate, transfer certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar card, and recent photographs.
  3. Interactive session / entrance assessment to understand child's learning aptitude.
  4. Final admission confirmation and fee settlement.
- **Prospectus & Forms**: Available online on the admissions portal or at the school administrative counter.

## 8. Notable Alumni Network
Little Flower School, Salempur alumni are serving worldwide across diverse fields:
- **Civil Services & Judiciary**: IAS, IPS, PCS officers, judges, and administrative personnel.
- **Medical Professionals**: Doctors, surgeons, and healthcare researchers across AIIMS, PGIMER, and premier medical institutes.
- **Engineers & Tech Leaders**: Software engineers, researchers, and entrepreneurs at global tech corporations (Google, Microsoft, Amazon, etc.).
- **Defense Forces**: Commissioned officers serving in the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force.
- **Academia & Business**: University professors, researchers, corporate leaders, and chartered accountants.

---

## 9. Code of Discipline & School Rules
1. Students shall maintain a high standard of good manners, honesty, truthfulness, and courteous behavior within and outside the school.
2. English must be spoken at all times in the campus to foster fluency and communication skills.
3. Strict punctuality and regular attendance are mandatory; latecomers and absentees must present an authorization letter from the Principal.
4. Clean, neat, and proper school uniform is compulsory on all working days.
5. School property must be treated with utmost care and respect.
6. Absolute silence is maintained during school assemblies and class transitions.
7. Mobile phones, electronic gadgets, and objectionable materials are strictly prohibited on campus.
8. Private tuitions from school faculty members are strictly forbidden.

---

## 10. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q: Which board is the school affiliated to?**
  A: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE), New Delhi for ICSE (Class 10) and ISC (Class 12).
- **Q: Where is Little Flower School located?**
  A: In Salempur, Deoria district, Eastern Uttar Pradesh (PIN: 274509), India.
- **Q: How can parents pay school fees?**
  A: Parents can pay fees online through the official fee payment portal (https://www.lfssalempur.online/payonline/) or via bank challan/counter.
- **Q: How to contact the school administration?**
  A: Call +91 94533 44112 / +91 87659 32092 or email littleflowersalempur@gmail.com.
